questions.question: In a vehicle without Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS), why should you pump your brakes to slow down?

options.text: It keeps air out of the brake line.
It prevents tires from wearing out.

questions.explanation: Pump your brakes gently to slow down or stop on slippery roads. If your vehicle has ABS, read your manual for how to use it.

questions.question: If an oncoming vehicle uses high beams, look toward ____ of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road if an oncoming vehicle's high beams are bright. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on course until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should:

options.text: Enter faster than traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Speed up to match the traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane to speed up to match traffic speed. Signal, look for an opening, accelerate, and merge into traffic safely.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow arrow traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should merge into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
Must come to a complete stop.
May turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
Have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means you can turn left in that direction. However, oncoming traffic has a green light, so you must yield to them and to pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: Your vehicle is blocking traffic after an accident. You should:

options.text: Move your vehicle off the road, if you can.
Wait for police before moving your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the road, if you can.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your vehicle off the road if possible. Always identify yourself and help if needed. Do not leave the scene.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is on top and green is on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What is the school zone speed limit?
questions.explanation: The school zone speed limit is 20 mph. Drive slowly and carefully where children are present.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling that they are about to stop. If you are following them, adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this emblem are driving 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What is the minimum penalty for driving without valid liability insurance?
questions.explanation: All vehicles must have liability insurance. If you cause an accident without insurance, or fail to show proof of insurance within 15 days, your license will be suspended for at least 90 days.

questions.question: If another car is coming at you in your lane, what should you do?

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and speed up.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay centered, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First, honk your horn to get the other driver's attention. If they do not move, steer to the right to escape. Steering left is dangerous because the other driver might also correct left. Brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces crash impact.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot of a large vehicle
An area designated for motor vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle
questions.explanation: "No zones" are the large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas.

questions.question: A work zone:

options.text: Is marked with black and white signs.
Does not require a driver to slow down and pay extra attention.

questions.explanation: Work zones can be stationary or moving (like lane striping, mowing, or snow removal vehicles). Work zones have orange signs with black lettering. Always slow down and pay close attention in work zones.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a circular yellow light.
You may turn in the direction of the arrow.
A green arrow is about to appear.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a circular yellow light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow light. When you see it, slow down and get ready for a red light.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as:
questions.explanation: A red flashing light means stop, just like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and go only when it is safe.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Keep them straight and set the parking brake.
Turn them away from the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a curbed street, turn your wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will roll into the curb instead of into traffic.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line on a multilane road mean?

options.text: Lanes are moving in opposite directions.
You may pass and change into the lane next to the dashed line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass and change into the lane next to the dashed line.
questions.explanation: Single dashed white lines separate lanes where you can change lanes. White lines separate lanes going in opposite directions.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.
